create_CQueue: create a fixed-size circular queue with preallocated slots for O(1) peek and sample operations
push_CQueue: push an element onto the tail of the circular queue and return True if successful
pop_CQueue: pop an element from the head of the circular queue and return the removed item
sample_CQueue: sample T consecutive elements from the circular queue for off-policy reinforcement learning replay
interval_pop_CQueue: iterate over a region of elements in the circular queue starting from a given offset
